description: Source code for DecoderBufferTranscryptor class handling buffer encryption/decryption in media GPU ChromeOS context.

classes.name: DecoderBufferTranscryptor
classes.description: Handles encryption and decryption of decoder buffers, manages task queue, and interacts with ChromeOS CDM context.

classes.name: TranscryptTask
classes.description: Represents a buffer and its associated decode callback for transcryption processing.

methods.name: EnqueueBuffer
methods.description: Adds a buffer and its decode callback to the queue for transcryption.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the transcryptor, aborting current tasks and clearing the queue.

methods.name: OnCdmContextEvent
methods.description: Handles CDM context events, triggers decryption when keys become available.

methods.name: DecryptPendingBuffer
methods.description: Initiates decryption of the next buffer in the queue if available.

methods.name: OnBufferTranscrypted
methods.description: Callback invoked after decryption attempt, handles success, error, or key issues.
